public.title: Test Runner IV
public.description: input is a suite/test descriptor forest. Suites have optional before/after hook-label arrays inherited outer-first/inner-first. Tests may include delay (nonnegative integer virtual time). Before hooks log "hook:label", delayed tests next log "wait:delay", then {name,pass}, then cleanup hooks. Tests run serially depth-first. Pass uses exact JSON serialization equality. Return log; virtual delays are observable events, no wall-clock waiting or real async callbacks. Supported inputs are valid for this contract. Aggregate JSON-serialized input is at most 512 UTF-8 bytes, nesting depth at most 6, arrays at most 40 items, operation/call lists at most 20 items, and individual strings at most 100 ASCII characters unless a tighter bound is stated. Integers have absolute value at most 1000; output arithmetic stays within safe integers. String object keys and string path segments are nonempty safe alphanumeric/underscore names excluding __proto__, constructor and prototype. Empty arrays/objects are allowed where consistent with the contract. Output ordering follows the rules above. These bounds include all nested payloads and all operations together.
hints: Separate the documented JSON representation from the behavior being modeled.
Preserve ordering and distinguish missing values, null, zero and false carefully.

explanation: Traverse serially and emit virtual await markers between setup and assertion results, then cleanup. O(nodes times depth plus assertion data and output), with no elapsed-time guarantees. Functional tests check the documented adapter behavior; they do not enforce implementation technique or prohibit built-in APIs.
